variants.HistGB_log1p: Keep B's 13 input fields and HistGB parameters; fit log1p(target), invert with expm1. Diagnostic of cross-room target scale and large-error weighting; not an unbiased original-scale mean estimator.
variants.HistGB_absolute: Keep B inputs and parameters except loss=absolute_error. Diagnostic of squared-error sensitivity and mean-vs-median objectives.
variants.HistGB_add_floor_WFR: Keep B inputs and squared-error HistGB; add Floor_0based and WFR_window_to_floor. Diagnostic of available but previously omitted BIM representations.
variants.HistGB_without_obstruction: Keep B inputs except Solar_Obstruction_Ratio; diagnostic of reliance on an annual scalar obstruction proxy.
variants.ExtraTrees_B: Same B inputs, ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=100,max_depth=12,min_samples_leaf=100,max_features=1.0,n_jobs=4,random_state=2026). Algorithm sensitivity comparison, not hyperparameter search.

scope: Exploratory diagnostics on development folds observed to fail; not independent final evaluation
